C0585.title: Douyin Store Penalized for Misleading Category Placement as False Advertising
C0585.summary: A Douyin store merchant was found to have intentionally placed products in incorrect categories to mislead consumers, an act deemed as false advertising. Under Articles 8 and 20 of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China, supervisory inspection departments may impose penalties for such conduct, clarifying the legal consequences of category misplacement.
